- Modified: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`, `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`, `ledgerly/models.py`.

Invoice covering index: doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress:
PDF fixes/tests, billing suite, and pagination/report work are done. Avatar next exact command: unavailable. No commands have unknown status.

PDF negative-line, money-format, and pagination fixes pass: 83 billing tests passed, 4 skipped; full baseline was 148 passed, 2 skipped. `models.py` began SQLAlchemy 2.0 modernization; webhook failure remains unresolved.
